JACOBIN: The CIA Is Up to No Good in Mexico
June 6, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Kurt Hackbarth in Jacobin on the CIA agents killed April 19 in Chihuahua: Trump's strategy is "stamp out every remaining progressive government in Latin America" and replace them with "far-right lackeys, stooges, criminals, and sellouts." 🇲🇽

CIA operating inside Mexico violates Mexican law. AP confirmed the agents' identities weeks ago — most US mainstream press has buried the story since. Sheinbaum has requested zero extraditions from the US despite Mexico submitting 269 to Washington since 2018. 💀

• "serve as an advance force for an eventual US invasion?"
• "Track down strategic mineral sites? Organize destabilization cells?"
• Sheinbaum demanded "evidence based in Mexican law"

🚨🇲🇽 <u>TRUMP'S TARIFFS DESTROYED 213,000 NORTH AMERICAN MANUFACTURING JOBS IN ONE YEAR — ECONOMÍA</u>

Mexico's Secretaría de Economía data, via El Economista: 111,347 Mexican manufacturing jobs and 102,000 US manufacturing jobs vanished between Feb 2025 and Feb 2026 — combined ~213,000 industrial positions destroyed by the tariff war. Heaviest losses: transport equipment, wood, plastics, rubber, and machinery. Economía's framing: "in many industries Mexico, the US, and Canada produce as a single integrated economy," so taxing every border crossing kills jobs in all three countries at once. Sheinbaum had already attributed 227,155 Mexican Q1 job losses to Trump's measures.

The "America First" tariff doctrine destroyed more US factory jobs than it created. The data is the indictment.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>FOVISSSTE GETS ITS CONSTRUCTOR POWERS BACK — 100,000 PUBLIC HOUSING UNITS COMING</u>

DOF published Friday June 5 the new Organic Regulation that returns FOVISSSTE — the state workers' housing fund — its historic faculty to build, rent, and sell housing directly. The neoliberal Infonavit/FOVISSSTE model since the 90s was credit-only: hand workers loans, let private developers warehouse the supply at whatever price. The new structure targets 100,000 units under the Vivienda para el Bienestar program, with fresh Subdirections of Vivienda, Financing Schemes, and Beneficiary Rights to run construction directly.

Forty years of "the market provides" replaced with the state building homes again.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>LATINUS-LINKED FIRM CHARGED IMSS BIENESTAR 200% OVER MARKET FOR DIALYSIS — THEN PULLED PLUG ON PATIENTS</u>

Zdenko SA de CV — under UIF investigation since 2023 for influence trafficking and money laundering, with reported payments to LatinUs and BCG Limited Consulting — was billing IMSS Bienestar 2,200 pesos per hemodialysis session when the market rate is 800. That's 200 percent over competitors and ~100 million pesos in Puebla alone for 2025. When IMSS ran the comparison and cancelled appointments, Zdenko unilaterally suspended treatment in June and November 2025. Related vendor BITA pulled the same move on 971 patients in State of Mexico.

The same right-wing media circuit that screams about "4T corruption" was getting paid 200 percent above market to keep kidney patients alive.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>US PUTS 9 MEXICAN MINERALS ON ITS "CRITICAL" LIST — 100% DEPENDENT ON OUR FLUORITE, GRAPHITE, STRONTIUM</u>

Washington's critical-minerals list now flags nine minerals Mexico supplies: 100 percent US dependency on fluorite, graphite, and strontium; 50–77 percent on silver, barite, zinc, refined copper, and selenium. The deposits sit in Sonora, Oaxaca, Guerrero, Chiapas, and Hidalgo — extracted today by Grupo México, Peñoles, and Canadian First Majestic. Overall the US imports more than 90 percent of 25 critical minerals and is now building the "Pax Silica" coalition with 14 allies to lock down semiconductor and AI supply chains.

Trump's empire needs Mexico's subsoil. Sheinbaum's job is not to hand it over cheap.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>PERU RUNOFF — FUJIMORI 52.5% VS SÁNCHEZ 47.5%, DYNASTY OF TORTURE GOES FOR FOURTH TRY</u>

Exit polls give Keiko Fujimori a narrow lead over leftist Roberto Sánchez in the June 7 runoff — Onpe early count puts it at 52.55 vs 47.45. Her father did 16 years for human rights crimes; she has lost three previous presidential bids. She would inherit a country that has run through ten presidents in a decade and stripped Pedro Castillo from office by parliamentary coup in 2022.

Sánchez ran on inequality and the gap between Lima and the rural sierra. A Fujimori win is the Lima oligarchy locking power back in; a Sánchez win would have been the Latin American left recovering ground after Boluarte's collapse.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>IRAN'S WORLD CUP SQUAD LANDS IN TIJUANA — SOVEREIGN HOST AS TRUMP WEAPONIZES VISAS</u>

Iran's national team touched down in Tijuana at 5am Sunday after the federation pulled its base out of Tucson, Arizona — Washington had refused visas to "key managerial and administrative" staff even after granting them to players 10 days before kickoff. Mexico took them in. The Guardia Nacional escorted the squad from the airport to Caliente stadium, where they'll train for the entire tournament while flying to Inglewood and Seattle for matches.

The US is at war with Tehran and uses immigration as a weapon. Sheinbaum's Mexico gave them a base, security, and a welcome at the gate.

🇲🇽🏭 17.6% OF EVERY FEDERAL PESO NOW GOES TO PENSIONS — 559.7B IN FIRST 4 MONTHS, HISTORIC HIGH

SHCP data published this week shows federal spending on contributory pensions hit 559,750 million pesos in January-April 2026 — a historic peak, 6.8% above the same period of 2025 in real terms. That's 17.6 of every 100 pesos of federal net spending, the highest share ever recorded. The figure exceeds combined federal spending on health and physical/financial investment (544.9 billion), tops health by 54.5%, and tops education by 84.2%. Atlas Network think tanks (IMCO, México Evalúa) frame it as "fiscal pressure" — what they refuse to mention is that the line includes the universal Pensión para el Bienestar de Adultos Mayores that Sheinbaum constitutionalized. (Source: El Economista, via SHCP fiscal report)

🇲🇽🌎 CDMX OPENS "CASA DE LAS PALABRAS" — PUBLIC CULTURAL LAB IN HISTORIC POET'S HOUSE

Mexico City inaugurated Casa de las Palabras on June 6 — a public cultural laboratory installed in the former Casa del Poeta Ramón López Velarde, with a Fondo de Cultura Económica bookstore, the capital's first public cabaret, the Nancy Cárdenas Hall (named for the pioneering Mexican lesbian playwright), and offices for PROCINECDMX and the Bienal del Cartel. "Casa de las Palabras arises where the Poet's House once stood," said culture secretary Ana Francis López Bayghen Patiño at the opening, which doubled as the awarding of the first Macuilxochitzin Young Poetry Prize in Indigenous Languages — given to Dewy Scarllet Anastacio Chino for a poemario in énná-mazatec. Public infrastructure for Indigenous languages, dissident narrative, and free access — while Washington defunds libraries and bans books at home.

🚨🇲🇽 THE PRIZE IS LITHIUM, RARE EARTHS AND WATER — CONTRALÍNEA MAPS THE SOFT-COUP OBJECTIVES

Contralínea spells out the operation against Sheinbaum's government in writing: Trump, Ambassador Ronald Johnson, the DEA and CIA, PAN/PRI/MC, Mexican bankers and media owners, and Atlas Network-funded NGOs (IMCO, México Evalúa, MCCI, Consejo Nacional de Litigio Estratégico) coordinating through embassy dinners, social-media offensives, and "low-intensity warfare." What gives it away is the prize: the article names control of Mexico's petroleum, lithium, rare earths and water as the actual strategic objective. The timeline is also dual-track — destabilize ahead of the November 2026 US elections and interfere in Mexico's 2027 midterms — with the Brazil 2016 and Venezuela playbooks as templates. CIA operations in opposition-governed Chihuahua under Maru Campos are cited as the live test run.
